Task: Improve the Templates modal and insert behavior so templates are complete, previewable, and insert as collapsible, labeled blocks.

Required edits:
1. Templates list:
   - Each template card must show: Title, 1-line description, tags (Persona, Research, Wireframe, Test), and a 3-line preview excerpt (first 120 characters).
   - Add a small "Sample" toggle on each card that opens a formatted sample usage example (not raw text).
2. Insert flow:
   - Add "Insert as Block" and "Insert Plain" options.
   - "Insert as Block" should insert a collapsible block into Notes with metadata header:
     ```
     --- TEMPLATE: <Name> | insertedAt: <ISO>
     [collapsible content area showing full template text]
     [button: Expand / Collapse]
     ```
   - The collapsible block must be easily removable and have a small edit icon to open the block in a mini-editor.
3. Template editor:
   - Allow quick variable substitution: fields such as {{projectName}}, {{platform}} replaced on insert with project-specific values (ask user for value if missing).
   - Add a "Complete Example" button that fills the template with example data to show how it will look in a real case study.
4. Templates content:
   - Ensure each template is turned into a full, ready-to-use copy: Persona template must include full field names and an example line; Research script must include 5 questions; Case Study outline should be filled with headings and example bullet points.
5. Return changed files and brief notes.

Testing instructions:
- Open Templates modal, search for "persona", click "Sample" to see example, click "Insert as Block" — in Notes you see a collapsible block labeled with template name and timestamp; expand it and see formatted content.
